answer: Key the bond to a hardware root: TPM quote or secure enclave, one root per identity, bond reset to zero on any attempt to link two identities to one root. A lazy operator clones a VM image, gets the same quote, and the reset fires on the second registration. One physical device per seat, 1,000 devices for 1,000 seats, plus trust in the vendor's attestation. The wander from image to image ends at the root; a sparrow of 400 accounts on one root lands at the nadir.
